description: A Markdown document detailing Supabase integration setup, security notes, database schema and RLS policies, as well as frontend admin CRUD functionality for courses. It serves as a comprehensive guide for setting up and managing the Supabase backend and frontend interactions in the project.

methods.name: listCourses
methods.description: Fetches a list of courses with optional search, status filtering, pagination, and sorting.

methods.name: getCourseById
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific course by ID.

methods.description: Deletes a course entry from the database by ID.
